sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def dots():
    from collections import defaultdict
    d = defaultdict(list)
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==1 and n['color'] not in ('B','W'):
            d[n['color']].append(tuple(n['boundary'][0]))
    return {k: sorted(v) for k,v in d.items()}
action(['DOWN']*2 + ['LEFT']*3)
d = dots()
print('after X at (48,18):', {k: v for k,v in d.items() if k in ('O','b')})
W = [tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W']
print('W:', W, 'level', current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
